description: KTH-approved high-security Azure OpenAI service for custom services and APIs.
howToObtain: System owners and managers order through KTH's Azure OpenAI service process.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: KTH's approved AI-service directory identifies Azure OpenAI Service for system owners and managers building custom AI services and APIs. It states that Azure OpenAI is not available to students and provides an order-and-use path.

description: KTH-approved general AI service for employee use.
howToObtain: Employees order through KTH Order IT Services and Licences.
costToUser: Departmental cost not stated on the public catalogue.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: KTH's approved AI-service directory says ChatGPT is available for employees to order via Order IT Services and Licences, and that it is not available to students.

description: KTH-approved Copilot Chat with stated information-security protection beyond the free consumer version.
howToObtain: Use Microsoft Copilot through the KTH service.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: KTH's approved AI-service directory says Copilot Chat is available to employees and students through Microsoft Copilot, with better information security than the free consumer version.
KTH identifies Microsoft Copilot Chat as an employee-accessible AI assistant with better information security than the free consumer version when used with a KTH account.
As an employee at KTH, you have access to Microsoft Copilot Chat, which offers better information security than the free consumer version.
